scientific_integrity: The reported coefficients are exact formal-series computations corroborated by direct exhaustive relational checks for n<=6; no independence or publication priority beyond the reviewed comparisons is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Finite frames only; two relation names remain distinguished; isomorphism types rather than labelled pairs; full journal article not read; possible unindexed prior unlabelled census. The established structural decomposition and labelled OEIS enumeration are prior results and are credited. A conference abstract in the 2021 Logic Colloquium book predates the exact-day 2022 author slides, but its exact public release day could not be verified.
title: Unlabelled census of finite commuting two-equivalence frames
